text:
maria_pm: Quick sync — PMs are getting multiple asks this quarter on inference perf. Customers want lower chat latency, better batch embedding throughput, and lower per-token cost for heavy usage. How should we prioritize?

josh_eng: tl;dr: can we split into 3 tracks? latency (chat), throughput (embeddings), cost optimizations (quant + cache).

maria_pm: That makes sense. We need a decision framework though — can't do everything. Thinking RICE + mandatory SLAs for enterprise customers.

liam_ml: +1 on RICE. For impact we should quantify: e.g., reducing chat P95 from 400ms -> 200ms increases conversion for our demo apps by ~8% (est). Throughput wins are measured in tokens/sec and $/1M tokens.

alex_data: I can run an analysis: map top 20 customers by token volume and estimate $ savings for each cost optimization. That will help the 'Reach' and 'Impact' inputs for RICE.

josh_eng: Operational constraints: latency wins often require model/kernel optimizations or smaller model variants + routing. Throughput wins are infra-level (batching, pooling) and affect Dedicated most. Cost work spans both.

sophia_sre: Risk part (R in RICE) should include reliability impact. Aggressive batching increases P95 tail for small requests unless we do dynamic batching. Also watch for KV cache invalidation complexity.

maria_pm: Proposed scoring sheet: Reach = monthly MAU affected estimate, Impact = prop lift on key metric (conv / SLA compliance), Confidence = evidence (benchmarks/customers), Effort = eng sprints. RICE score = (Reach * Impact * Confidence) / Effort.

josh_eng: For sequencing: 1) Low-effort, high-impact cache + prefix caching for chat (small infra changes) 2) Dynamic batching for embeddings (medium effort, big cost/throughput wins) 3) Kernel optimizations / quantization path for aggressive latency (higher effort + risk).

liam_ml: Agree. Also include canary plan in launch criteria: canary 5% traffic for 48h, monitor P95, error rate, and quality regressions via eval prompt set.

alex_data: Example launch criteria we can use as strings: "P95_lat_chat <= 200ms OR <= baseline*0.6", "throughput_tokens_s increase >= 2x for embeddings in Dedicated", "net cost per 1M tokens decrease >= 15% for host tier". All measured with current prod workload.

sophia_sre: Add rollback thresholds: +10% errors or +30% P95 regression triggers immediate rollback. Deploy-bot: scheduled canaries should auto-rollback if thresholds tripped.

deploy-bot: canary created: env=prod, pct=5, duration=48h, monitor=[p95_latency, error_rate, eval_quality].

maria_pm: Customer asks: Acme health wants <120ms chat latency for triage flow (enterprise). Is that realistic for Q2?

josh_eng: 120ms is tough on hosted without model changes; maybe dedicated + pinned lower context model variant could hit it. Need to scope as "enterprise-only, dedicated offering" and add to pricing/packaging discussion.

liam_ml: We should also include quality guardrails in priority: any quant/latency change needs automated evals for hallucination/precision on curated prompts. Can't trade quality for raw latency.

maria_pm: Final ask: josh + alex + liam put a RICE spreadsheet mock by EOD Fri with numbers and a recommended ordered list. We'll use that in roadmap planning next week. Keep notes short in this thread. :thumbsup:

josh_eng: will do.

liam_ml: I'll add eval baselines and expected confidence intervals.

alex_data: I'll pull customer volume and cost impact tomorrow morning and link the sheet here.

sophia_sre: I'll write the rollback thresholds into the deployment playbook draft and share a PR.

maria_pm: thanks team — this is our decision framework. We'll reconvene after the RICE numbers to sequence work into the roadmap.
